basic_details.job_title: Central University of Jammu Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Junior Research Fellow / Senior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: Applications are invited for the post of one Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/ Senior Research Fellow (SRF) under the Indo-Swiss Joint Research Project titled “Ice nucleating particles and cloud condensation nuclei properties in the North-Western Himalayas (ICE-CRUNCH)” at the Central University of Jammu. Funded by the Ministry of Earth Sciences (MoES), the post offers a consolidated monthly fellowship of Rs. 37,000 + 8% HRA for JRF and Rs. 42,000 + 8% HRA for SRF, with an essential qualification of an M.Sc. in Environmental Sciences / Atmospheric Sciences with a minimum of 55% marks and NET/GATE

how_to_apply: Interested candidates who fulfill the above conditions may send their application form along with a CV, academic transcripts, work certificate (if any) and a 1-page motivation letter stating previous research experience and interests along with contact details through post or e-mail.
The complete application form (on format attached as Annexure I) along with self-attested testimonials shall be mailed or sent.
Mention post name and reference number on top of the envelope.

Send to: Dr. Shweta Yadav (Principal Investigator), D-35, Department of Environmental Sciences, Central University of Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), Distt. Samba- 181143, Jammu (J&K), India, Email: [email protected], Contact no: 8700244971.
important_instructions: Mentioning post name and reference number on top of the envelope is required. The selected individual may be assigned any other duties from time to time commensurate with his/her qualifications. Central University of Jammu reserves every right to cancel out the process and /or not to fill this temporary position at any stage of selection process. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: About CUJ Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The Central University of Jammu, located at Rahya-Suchani, (Bagla), Distt. Samba, Jammu & Kashmir- 181143, is conducting recruitment for an Indo-Swiss Joint Research Project in collaboration with ETH Zurich, Switzerland. The project presents a unique opportunity to study aerosol properties over a high-altitude site in Jammu region.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification fills a total of one temporary position.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfill the essential qualifications specified for the respective post: For JRF: M.Sc. in Environmental Sciences / Atmospheric Sciences with a minimum of 55% marks and NET/GATE Examination Qualified. For SRF: Qualification prescribed for JRF with two years of research experience. Desirable Qualification: The candidate having in-depth knowledge of aerosol measurement techniques and data analysis using MATLAB, Python or similar software / languages will be given preference. For SRF: Publication of at least one paper in a peer reviewed SCI indexed journal in the relevant field.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post will be filled up purely on contract basis for one year or completion of the project whichever is earlier. Candidates will have no right to claim any regular appointment. The consolidated monthly fellowship is JRF: Rs. 37,000 + 8% HRA and SRF: Rs. 42,000 + 8% HRA.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CUJ Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Interested candidates who fulfill the above conditions may send their application form along with a CV, academic transcripts, work certificate (if any) and a 1-page motivation letter stating previous research experience and interests along with contact details through post or e-mail. The complete application form (on format attached as Annexure I) along with self-attested testimonials shall be mailed or sent. Mention post name and reference number on top of the envelope. Send to: Dr. Shweta Yadav (Principal Investigator), D-35, Department of Environmental Sciences, Central University of Jammu, Rahya-Suchani (Bagla), Distt. Samba- 181143, Jammu (J&K), India, Email: [email protected] , Contact no: 8700244971.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The candidate will be shortlisted for the interview based on merit and will be informed via e-mail. Mere fulfilling the minimum qualifications will not entitle the candidate for being called for an interview. The decision of the selection committee will be final in this regard. Candidates shortlisted for interview should appear in person with originals of degree certificates (one set of self-attested photocopies) and a proof for date of birth (Class 10th Certificate) along with any other relevant information (e.g. experience certificate, copies of publications if any, awards, recommendations letters, etc.). No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Mentioning post name and reference number on top of the envelope is required. The selected individual may be assigned any other duties from time to time commensurate with his/her qualifications. Central University of Jammu reserves every right to cancel out the process and /or not to fill this temporary position at any stage of selection process. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview.
